warnings: Max R-hat 1.012 exceeds 1.01: chains have not mixed, so posterior summaries are unreliable.

notes: 135 of 211 periods are zero, so a hurdle model is used: a Bernoulli component for whether a period is non-zero and a Gamma component for its level. The target is never rounded and no epsilon is added to force a Gamma to accept a zero.
Integer count target; variance/mean = 21.21, so a Negative Binomial is used to admit overdispersion a Poisson would not.
